q1_issues.issue: The specificational copula "Counties with population declines will be Vermillion, Posey and Madison" is silently re-encoded as three attributive With predications, so the identifying (and exhaustive) claim of the clause is nowhere recorded and the clause's own future tense is relocated onto the decline witnesses.

q2_gaps: specificational copular clause whose complement is a list of names identifying the subject description ("the Ns are A, B and C"): no identity head is defined and no carrier exists for the exhaustivity such a clause asserts
notes: The three coordinated names distribute correctly (one decline witness each), each county gets its Name plus the kind atom readable off the subject NP, and population_decline gets its genus with the noun modifier correctly unexposed. Future on the event-noun witnesses is the only tense carrier left once the copula is restructured, so it is the best available placement rather than an added claim.
